summary:
Architectural plan to give Smork complete real-time control over Smoky Zone from mobile phone or laptop:
- Floating Lock Button & Fast Passcode Modal (smork2026 default, customizable)
- Comprehensive Live Admin Studio: upload and replace any image, 5-second cultural short video clip, official playlist MP3, portfolio screenshot, or text label directly from device gallery or camera
- Cloud Database & Media Persistence with local IndexedDB/LocalStorage instant caching so all visitors worldwide see updates in real time
- Full touchscreen mobile ergonomics and responsive laptop layout adhering to Smoky Zone's electric cobalt aesthetic
